messages:
zoe-billing: Heads-up: customer BrightLane (acct BL-881) failed ACH onboarding. Gateway returned 'tax_id_mismatch' when attempting microdeposits. Invoice 56090 ($7,200) is due in 48h. Customer asked if we can accept a one-time wire while they fix the tax ID.
henry-payments: That error is different from account_type_mismatch — looks like the bank validated company tax ID against account name. Do we have their EIN on file?
zoe-billing: On file says EIN 12-3456789 but customer treasury used 12-3456780 (typo). They offered to submit corrected ACH later but need a wire to avoid interruption.
ops-oncall: Pause autopay retries for BL-881 to avoid double-charges while this is open.
billing-bot: Payment attempt 2027-09-10 09:32 UTC failed (txn: pay_l0k9). Retry policy would kick in; recommend pause.
nora-finance: No disputes. Amount <$50k, so VP sign-off not strictly required but please include signed addendum for audit since this is a routing/workaround. Also confirm customer will cover wire fees.
henry-payments: I'm okay accepting wire if customer agrees on fees + signed addendum. @cecilia-vpfinance do you want to waive signature requirement?
cecilia-vpfinance: No waiver. Approve acceptance of one-time wire for invoice 56090 ($7,200) conditional on: remittance email to billing@redwood.ai with bank trace, customer signs the one-off billing addendum, and they confirm they will cover outgoing fees. Proceed.
zoe-billing: Sending wiring instructions + pro-forma now. Pausing autopay retries and CCing support & finance.
zoe-billing: Wire instructions (sent to customer):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Riverbank (US clearing)
Routing (ABA): 054000016
Account: 9988776655
SWIFT: RIVBUS33
Reference: Invoice 56090 - BL-881
Remittance email: billing@redwood.ai
Note: Please ensure the wire covers intermediary fees so Redwood receives the full invoice amount.
```
henry-payments: Once we receive remittance + signed addendum and bank trace, we'll mark invoice settled and cancel pending retries.
billing-bot: Flag created: MANUAL_WIRE-9901. Attach addendum + remittance trace for audit.
zoe-billing: Customer replied: "Treasury initiating wire now; corrected ACH will be resubmitted after payment."
nora-finance: I'll reconcile after the bank posts and then close the ticket. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
